in_hebrew.name: לעלי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: לעלי הוא שם יהודי שמקורו בעברית, שפה המדוברת בארץ ישראל. השם עלי (לעלי) נמצא במקרא, ומופיע בעיקר כתארת שם. אף על פי שהשם עלי (לעלי) נראה כאדם עני, יכול להצטרף לקהל ה' ולא להיות חסר. באופן כללי, השם עלי (לעלי) יכול לשמש דוגמה לעצמאות ועצמה.

in_greek.name: Λαήλειος
in_greek.long_meaning: Λαήλειος είναι ονομασία ελληνική, που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα. Η λέξη λαιός (λαήλειος) αναφέρεται σε ένα άτομο που είναι φτωχός. Ωστόσο, η λέξη λαιός δεν αναφέρεται μόνο σε ένα άτομο που είναι φτωχός, αλλά και σε ένα άτομο που είναι ανεξάρτητο και αυτοδύναμο. Το όνομα Λαήλειος μπορεί να θεωρηθεί ως ένα σύμβολο της ανεξαρτησίας και της αυτοδύναμης.

in_latin.name: Laelius
in_latin.long_meaning: Laelius est nomen Latinum, quod a lingua Latina orta est. Nomen Laelius significat pauperem, sed non solum pauperem. Hoc nomen potest esse exemplum libertatis et autonomiae.

in_english.name: Laelio
in_english.meaning: poor or humble person, symbol of independence and autonomy
in_english.long_meaning: Laelio is a Christian name with roots in Hebrew and Greek. The name Laelio is believed to be derived from the Greek word לעלי (laeli), meaning poor or humble person. However, the word Laeli is not only associated with poverty but also with independence and autonomy. The name Laelio can be seen as a symbol of the qualities that are essential in a Christian, such as humility, independence, and self-sufficiency.

biblical_reference.note: The name Laeli is mentioned in the Bible as a symbol of humility and independence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Laelio (pronounced: la-EL-ee-oh) has Roman origins, belonging to an ancient family named Laelius. This name symbolizes having a strong connection to the people, community, and the societal values of the Roman culture. The name Laelio carries with it an aspect of leadership, wisdom, and dedication, reflecting the ideals of the ancient Roman civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, the name Laelio holds deeper significance for those who value praying to saintly figures. Saint Laelius or Saint Lalius is a little-known saint venerated in Argentina. Brother Laelio de Linus, one of the founders of the Hermandad de Laínz, a Dominican and Franciscan fraternity in Argentina, is also named Laelio. For those drawn to his spirituality, the name Laelio emphasizes dedication, devotion to God, and community in the spiritual journey.

historical_references.reference: Laelius, a Roman nobleman and statesman, friend of Cicero and Marcus Terentius Varro, was born in 95 BC.
